title: Doesn't let water through, holes are too small for water to pass through.
text: Doesn't let water through, holes are too small for water to pass through.. I had cleaned my shower previous to using this and was just trying these out, it did not work well. It was not even draining any water while I was showering and started to create a small puddle around my drain and my feet. The holes are too small and it was not effective. I also found it to be a lot smaller than another version I had previously bought on amazon that only had one single one as well, but much better quality since the holes are bigger and actually let water through. Never buying this again, I got way too many and will probably not use any of them sadly.
